ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with dominant low-intensity (black) base pixels occupying approximately 92-95% of the visible surface area, contrasted by high-intensity (white/beige) pixels in sparse linear and circular distributions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black field across both lobes. High-intensity white linear streaks are randomly distributed. Clusters of beige/off-white high-intensity pixels are localized on the far-left and far-right distal tips and along the inferior leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 110 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the vertical lobe height from the base to the highest trailing edge peak.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile with medium-frequency peaks and valleys. Notable high-amplitude jagged projections on the upper interior sections of both lobes; amplitude varies from 5 to 20 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trailing edge displays a concave trajectory sweeping upward toward the tips; outer leading edges show a convex curve terminating at sharp, barnacle-encrusted distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast beige pixel groups (barnacles) at the distal tips. Internal lobe surfaces contain multiple faint, white circular ring-shaped scars, particularly on the left lobe central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions across both lobes. Distinct groupings of 3-5 parallel linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the mid-left lobe and the lower-right lobe section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear scarring/rake marks across the majority of the black pigmentation; dense colonization by sessile organisms (barnacles) along the margins and tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced beige-colored protrusion of organisms along the outer perimeter, creating a discontinuous, textured border distinct from the smooth fluke edge.
